input: Get my eyes tested for new glasses

gold.taskTitle: Get eyes tested and order new glasses
gold.taskDescription: Book and attend an eye test in order to get a new glasses prescription and acquire new glasses.

questions.title: When did you last have an eye test?
questions.description: Understanding how long ago the last test was helps determine urgency and whether a referral or specific test type is needed.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred optician or clinic?
questions.description: Knowing if there is an existing optician relationship avoids needing to search for a new one from scratch.

questions.title: Are you covered by insurance or a vision plan?
questions.description: Insurance or vision benefit coverage affects which providers are eligible and what costs the user will face.

questions.title: What is driving the need for new glasses now?
questions.description: Understanding the reason — blurred vision, broken frames, style change — shapes the priority and scope of the task.

questions.title: Do you need glasses for a specific use case?
questions.description: Knowing whether the glasses are for reading, driving, screens, or general use determines what to discuss with the optician.

questions.title: What is your target date to have new glasses?
questions.description: A deadline helps set urgency for booking the appointment and allows time for ordering and delivery of frames.

questions.title: Do you have a budget in mind for the glasses?
questions.description: A budget guides frame and lens choices and determines whether premium options like coatings or designer frames are relevant.
